name: fo-payroll-levy
description: Compute Faroese lønarhæddaravgjald for healthcare, insurance, banking, savings-bank, finance and the specified necessary electronic services in 2026. Distinguishes the healthcare wage-plus-business-profit base from the insurance and finance wage-only bases, mixed activities, benefits in kind, provisional quarterly demands and final annual reconciliation. Gives the TAKS registration field, payment-agreement identifiers, statutory payment deadlines, refunds, interest, correction demands and penalties. Trigger on Faroe Islands payroll levy, wage tax for VAT-exempt businesses, medical practice levy, insurance wage levy, financial-sector payroll tax and lønarhæddaravgjald. This levy is the business's liability, separate from employees' income-tax withholding and social contributions.
